text:
Solomode is back! Let's create some solo modes!

See the results
Contest geeklist
Quick overview of entries

The original Solomode contest was created by Mario Lanza, who hosted it in 2020 and 2021. It was rebooted in 2023 by yours truly (with Mario's support).

The idea of this contest is designing of a solo mode for a game that does not have one, or has a one that you find lacking. The winner will be determined by voting, similar to other BGG community design contests, and there is a feedback requirement for all entrants. The winners will get geekgold, but the real prize is the exchange of ideas with fellow designers, and making your designs better.

Dates
 Earliest date for the solo mode to be publicly available: July 1st, 2023
 Submissions: March 1st to May 15th, 2024
 Deadline for mandatory feedback: May 25th, 2024 June 30th, 2024 (Midnight PST)
 Development: Until June 1st, 2024
 Final vote: June 10th to June 30th, 2024

How to participate
Designers
 Create a solo mode for a game you love.
 Create a thread in the Variants forum of the game that you are creating the solo mode for. Your thread's title should start with "[2024 Solomode]". Please mention in your opening post that your solo mode is an entry in the Solomode contest, with a link to the contest thread.
 Add a post to the contest thread, with a link to your solo mode.
 Add your thread to the Contest geeklist (this is how to do it).
 Post feedback to other entries in this contest (at least one for each solo mode you enter).
 Vote for the solo modes you have played, or read the rules for.

Players
 Playtest the solo modes, and post your feedback.
 Vote for the solo modes you have played, or read the rules for.

Contest rules
 Valid entries are fan made rules that add a mode for solo play to an existing game. The game may already have an official solo mode (or even an unofficial one).
 If the game already has a solo mode, your solo mode should be significantly different and have enough original elements. It shouldn't be just a small tweak to the existing solo mode.
 Any additional components are allowed, whether standard dice, meeples, cubes etc. or custom PnP components. In case of PnP components, a file in PDF format should be provided.
 To enter, create a thread in the Variants forum for the base game and announce it in the contest thread.
 Your thread's title should start with "[2024 Solomode]" and your opening post should include a link to this thread.
 The solo mode should not have been made public prior to July 1st, 2023. The contest is meant for new designs.
 You can enter up to two entries in the contest.
 For each of your entries, you are required to provide meaningful feedback to one other designer. You are not required to playtest the game if you don't happen to own it. You may simply watch a playthrough video for the base game and give feedback for the solo mode rules.
 The most important rule is to have fun!

The Fine Print
The contest host reserves the right to resolve any issues in the spirit of the contest.
The rights for your creations stay with you at all times.

Recommendations
 Write a rulebook (link a document on Google Drive, for example). Don't just list out rules in your OP. Make your rulebook clear, accessible and well formatted. Include some examples. The rules are where you lose or gain players!
 Answer rules questions as promptly as you can.
 Post rules and other updates as separate posts in your thread, to trigger subscriptions and bump your thread in the games forum.
 Give feedback to fellow designers beyond the required 1 per entry. Be nice in your feedback. While you cannot generally expect a one on one reciprocation, the more you give, the more you will receive, and reviewing someone else’s solo mode might trigger an idea that helps you solve a problem in your own design.
 If you don't get players, post a link to your solo mode on the game's Facebook and Reddit groups. And feel free to ask for feedback in this thread!
 Post a link to a good playthrough video of the base game in your OP, to help those playtesters who are not yet acquainted with the game.
 Make your solo mode feel as close to the multiplayer game as possible (but the bot does not need to play the same as the human player ).
 Give a title to your solo mode.
 List the required components in your OP and the geeklist entry.

Voting
 Voting will be done via Google Forms, same as last year and similar to other BGG contests.
 To vote, you need to have a BGG account (created before the start of the contest).
 You can vote for multiple solo modes - the ones you have played, and the ones you have just read the rules for.
 Designers can (and are encouraged to) vote for their own entries.

Categories
 Best Solo Mode
 Best Rulebook
 Best Official Solo Mode Replacement
 Best Light Game Solo Mode
 Best Medium Complexity Game Solo Mode
 Best Complex Game Solo Mode
 Best AI System
 Best First Time Solo Mode Designer Opt in - please mention in your OP if this is your first solo mode
 Best Name
 Most Valuable Playtester
